units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 7:1">Targ. Ps. VII, 1</cite> <he>ת׳ דאודייתא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>תִּירְגָּמָא</he>; Regia <cite ref="V00285"><he>תִּרְגְּמָא</he></cite>; ed. Ven. <cite ref="V00288"><he>תורגמנא</he></cite>) a shout (song) of thanksgiving (h. text <he>שגיון</he>).

<cite ref="Megillah 3a:10">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>אלמלא ת׳ דהאי קרא וכ׳</he> but for the Aramaic rendering of that verse (<cite ref="Zechariah 12:11">Zech. XII, 11</cite>) we should never have known what it means; a. fr.
